newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya bank lifts Nairobi bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Kenya bank lifts Nairobi bourse index.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Wednesday boosted by a renewed buying interest in Kenya Commercial Bank, brokers said.
The index gained 18.38 points to stand at 3392.10. Turnover was posted at 34.873 million shillings on 547,053 shares compared to 35.500 million shillings on 694,414 shares.
Kenya Commercial Bank gained five shillings to close at 96.
"Everyone was expecting the price to come down since buying orders were completed last week," a broker told Reuters.
"But there were fresh orders today all from foreign investors and so the price might hold," he added.
Brokers added that in general, the overall market sentiment remained the same -- bearish, amid lucklustre trade.
"There is a lot of selling pressure, much more than demand in the market," a senior broker said.
Barclays Bank eased to 112 from 115, while Uchumi Supermarket edged a shilling to close at 36.

Kenya Power & Lighting Co gained 2.0 to 118. The share, which see-sawed between 122 and 118 in the past week, was expected to ease further now that bonus share certificates had been released to shareholders, brokers said.

The company offered a bonus issue of two shares for every one held in January. "It was quite a hefty bonus and there's been demand for the share, so we're expecting investors to sell off some of the excess shares," another broker said.
Rea Vipingo Plantations closed at 9.85 from 9.75 while Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.50.
